recipe.normalization: Finite medians and mean/std fitted on unique training groups once; validation/test never enter fit

recipe.calibration: Pooled unique validation group scores only; no point adjustment
recipe.test_policy: Every timestamp of every registered held-out source, no sampling or dropped tails
